title: EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.33839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain resul

translated_title: EdgeDeID：一个无需真实患者数据训练的0.6B参数临床去标识化模型
translated_abstract: 使用托管（云端）语言模型对临床笔记进行去标识化处理，反而会泄露这一步骤本想保护的信息。我们提出了EdgeDeID，一个0.6B参数的仅解码器架构去标识化模型，它可以在本地运行，且训练过程完全不使用真实患者文本：三个大语言模型教师撰写合成笔记，由单一标注者将其重新标注为统一规范，模型则学习输出其所识别标识符的类型化XML模式。在一个包含100条笔记、标注经人工验证的合成域内基准测试中，该模型达到0.994的微平均F1分数，并在99%的笔记中实现零标识符遗漏；相比之下，八个现成系统中最强的一个分别仅为0.857和12%。量化后，该模型可在CPU上以615MB的内存运行。在监督训练之外的三项改进中，只有验证器适配器有效：它能以0.94的AUROC区分其他系统输出的完整与不完整结果，而采用召回率加权奖励的强化学习和基于规则的后处理层对域内结果没有带来改善。
tldr: 提出EdgeDeID——一个仅用合成数据训练、无需真实患者文本即可本地运行的0.6B参数临床去标识化模型，在基准测试中达到0.994微F1且99%的笔记无遗漏，量化后仅需615MB即可在CPU上运行。
en_tdlr: EdgeDeID is a 0.6B-parameter clinical de-identifier trained entirely on synthetic notes without real patient data, achieving 0.994 micro-F1 with zero missed identifiers in 99% of notes while running on CPU in just 615 MB.
